title: Install location missing in Uninstall registry entry
author: vanzue
summary: The uninstall registry entry created by older PowerToys installers omitted InstallLocation.
next_action: Close as handled by the current installer implementation, subject to a maintainer confirming the shipped release.

confidence.rationale: The requested value is written explicitly by current installer code and tied to a merged PR.

judgment.rationale: Current main contains an installer custom action that writes InstallLocation for the matching per-user or per-machine bundle, introduced by merged PR 41132 after this report.
evidence: The report identifies the missing value under the uninstall registry entry in PowerToys 0.94.0.
Current Product.wxs schedules SetBundleInstallLocation during install or upgrade.
SetBundleInstallLocationCA writes the bundle InstallLocation value in HKCU or HKLM.
Git history attributes the addition to merged PR 41132.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as handled by the current installer implementation, subject to a maintainer confirming the shipped release.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR 41132 added the installer custom action that writes the requested uninstall entry.

issue_context.summary: The uninstall registry entry created by older PowerToys installers omitted InstallLocation.
known_information: The issue was filed against 0.94.0 auto-update.
Current source handles both per-user and per-machine uninstall hives.
The custom action runs on fresh install or detected upgrade.
inferences: Builds containing PR 41132 should populate InstallLocation for the matching bundle entry.
issue_context.analysis: The requested registry behavior now exists in public main, so a new fix design would duplicate a merged implementation.
initial_investigation: Traced the addition to commit f1367bfa17a47f2a56a064885a1ec3f07165fbe5 / PR 41132.

actions.label: Close as implemented in current installer

comment.body: Current PowerToys installer source now schedules `SetBundleInstallLocation` on install or upgrade and writes the matching uninstall entry's `InstallLocation` value for per-user or per-machine installs. This was added in PR #41132 after the 0.94.0 report. If maintainers confirm the fix is present in a shipped release, this issue can be closed as handled.
